author: Hathanh N.
text: Spacious site, beautiful creek, nice flat terrain for the tent, just wish there were tables at the sites :) Will be back!

author: Lisa S.
text: Nice to not be bothered by staff/owners. Really quiet area. Could use a few more signs and more privacy at lake site. Thank you

author: Mackenzie R.
text: This is my favorite place to visit for some nature time with my dog, and this time I brought some friends to experience the magic, as well! A lovely time, as always! Thank you Lauren & Jeremy for sharing your land with us! Show more

author: Kelley C.
text: Camp Cedar Creek is lush, beautiful, and magical. I stayed here with my two kids, 10 and 12, and we all had an incredible time along the creek. Our only regret was not staying longer. We will definitely be back. Show more

author: Bethany F.
text: We love camping here and look forward to coming back! Also the hosts were so helpful when navigating uncertainty due to wildfire this year.

author: Adriana G.
text: Lovely little commune, will definitely be staying again :) Would choose a site with more privacy next time!!!

author: Heather T.
text: My family and I loved camping at this beautiful property. Camp Cedar Creek has such a picturesque setting that it was hard to believe we were less than an hour from our house. The campground was full during our stay and all of the neighboring campers were quiet and respectful after hours. The hosts were very accommodating and friendly offering up plenty of additional services and rental items to help make the stay even more enjoyable. I would highly recommend this site to all campers, we cannot wait to make more memories with our kids here! Show more

author: Lily K.
text: our 4th time staying here - always a delight and you can’t go wrong with any of the sites :)

author: Carmen H.
text: We had a great time camping here! Our dogs had so much fun exploring the creek. The sites aren’t super close together which allows a little bit of privacy. We stayed at the Lions Mane and would definitely come again Show more

author: Noelle S.
text: Such a gorgeous site and felt very private! Falling asleep to the sound of the creek running right past the tent was so relaxing. Definitely planning on another visit!

author: Ashley F.
text: Personally I loved this spot! The campground was SUPER easy to get to thanks to the thorough instructions from the hosts, it was green and gorgeous and I like that I could see the campers around! It felt like a little a little camping community. Also the hosts had tons of cool things you could rent from them and were super responsive! I would go again in a heartbeat. Show more

author: Joshua D.
text: It was our first time at this spot and it was awesome! Everything was nice and laid out great. It might be confusing at first, but trust the process. We do plan on going back! Thanks yall!

author: Van P.
text: Great location and the campsite was awesome. The Blue Barn was definitely worth the add on. I will definitely return. Hard to believe you were so close to the main road. Felt like you were off the beaten track. Beautiful creek and setting. Big campsites. Show more

author: Aylene S.
text: Great spot, right at the end and very private. But there is no level ground and no amenities. Even the porta potty had no toilet paper. Too high of a price for what you get.

author: Susan M.
text: Lauren and Jeremy's land is amazing. We had the most wonderful time. The bathrooms were clean and all the campsites are excellent. Falling asleep to the sound of the creek is just bliss. It's so close to Portland and yet you feel like you're all alone in the middle of the woods. The weekend got a little busier and the campground got a little busier. There were dogs and kids and happy voices everywhere and yet the campground still seemed private. We will definitely be back! Show more

author: Naomi W.
text: I absolutely loved my stay here! The area was so peaceful and Lauren, Jeremy, and Juno made us feel right at home! As a car camping traveler, this place was absolutely everything I could ask for! I highly recommend it and will most definitely be back as soon as possible! Show more

author: Rachel C.
text: We were just here for an overnight, but enjoyed it very much. It was nice to cook in the big communal kitchen rather than on my tiny van counter, we all had fun with the ping pong table in the rec room, wifi was fast, restrooms/ showers were nice and clean, and we enjoyed chatting with Jeremy over coffee! Our RAM Promaster struggled a bit to get back up one of the steep switchbacks in the driveway until we turned off the pesky traction control :) Thanks for a nice stay! Show more

author: Nicole L.
text: Camp Cedar Creek is a gem. It's just off 26, and super convenient to lots of hiking and amenities but it feels nice and remote. I van camped with my partner, and having the Blue Barn with a fully stocked kitchen, hang out zone, ping pong table, and clean showers and bathrooms was super handy. We loved walking down to the creek and hiking around the trails, and Jeremy and Lauren (and Juno!) were very welcoming. Show more

author: Deborah L.
text: Beautiful surroundings, Especially down by the creek Nice barn bathroom and wifi was great after a week camping without both. Also the Hosts were very kind to help me get the app working better Show more

author: Josh D.
text: Need a place to park the van, get into nature and have access to any amenities you need? This is the place! I've stayed here a few nights now and will be continuing to stay weekly for work in the area. The entry road and most spots are accessible with my 2wd 97 1 ton camper conversion van and there's special 4wd areas as well. The blue barn has everything you could need to make coffee, shower and relax, work out, work remotely and even cook a full meal like you would at home with the oversized kitchen. This place is a dream spot. 10/10 Show more

author: Julian B.
text: We loved our quick overnight at the Blue Barn! After spending a few weeks on the road in the rig, the hot showers, full kitchen, work spaces, and hangout spaces were such a treat. Lauren and Jeremy are incredible Hipcamp Hosts and I will certainly be back the next time I find myself between Bend and Portland. Show more

author: Susan M.
text: This was a great place to stop over near Mt. Hood! Clean with all the amenities - I happened to be there when it was mostly empty which meant I got to do all my laundry and not worry about holding others up 😊 Lauren and Jeremy were very welcoming! Definitely recommend staying here! Show more

author: Hannah G.
text: I stayed by the barn in a car camping spot. Easy access with kitchen, bathrooms, gym area. I worked remotely one of the days and was quiet and a great setup. Walking to the creek also recommend:) Would stay again! Show more

author: Alex C.
text: While this was my first Hipcamp experience, I've traveled, camped, co-worked, and AirBNB'd all over the world... and this place is excellent. The hosts Jeremy & Lauren are absolute professionals, incredibly accommodating, communicative, and friendly. If you're looking for well cared for campground with nature, space, and all the amenities, this is it. If you're looking for a place you can work and find friendly welcoming community, their co-working loft at the Blue Barn (has A/C too) is far better than the nicest coffee shop. Need a very dog friendly spot? Check. Traveling in your van and ready to rest, recharge, meet some people, enjoy a clean kitchen with everything you need, or take a hot shower? Stay here. Can't say enough good things really. The driveway and 4WD requirements for the campground next to the creek are to be taken seriously. If you're self contained in 2WD the van spots at the Blue Barn are accessible. And, this specific site can also be tent friendly. Show more

author: Jeremy S.
text: If you have second thoughts, just book this place. The views are incredible, the privacy is there, and the amenities are refreshing. Will be coming back.

author: Rachael B.
text: The hosts have excellent communication and a beautiful site.

author: Jessica W.
text: I thoroughly enjoyed car camping here! Lauren and Jeremy thought of everything, the place is pretty easy to get to with each site marked clearly. The barn is stocked with everything you could need with a full kitchen, dining area, gym equipment, ping pong table, lounge area, coworking space and 2 full bathrooms. I was able to use the fridge and freezer too and they provide tape & a marker to label what’s yours. Everything was clean and well maintained and organized. Also loved how detailed the check in instructions are. I cannot wait to come back here on my next road trip and cannot recommend this place enough! Show more

author: Rachael B.
text: Great communication, flexibility, and a beautiful location. Thank you!

author: Branden B.
text: Well laid out site with clean showers and bathroom. Fair amount of kitchen items and space in the coworking area next to the sites if needed. Charging is available for a fee.

author: Rebecca D.
text: The whole world property is lovely and the owners are great! We stayed in our van outside the barn, the dogs got to play while we worked or worked out, the bathrooms are clean and comfortable, and the kitchen has everything you need (baking cookies is extra special when you live in a van without an oven!). I definitely recommend staying here and will be back when we come through Oregon again Show more

author: Michelle M.
text: This place is amazing and the hosts were so welcoming. I'm hoping to visit again soon.

author: Peggi J.
text: Beautiful spot with every imaginable amenity. It was great to shower and get some work done in a magical spot.

author: Ian H.
text: This was a perfect location to get out of Portland for a few days while working during the week. The barn was a fantastic coworking space and the stream through the property was a great respite between meetings. We were able to get our pop-up A-frame trailer in pretty easily. Note there wasn't electric or water hook ups but we didn't need it with the kitchen, showers, toilets, etc. all right inside. Show more
